name: Ground Turkey Taco Stuffed Peppers

fit.note: 438 cal is within 400-650; 13.7g carbs is well under 35g; scales by pepper count with weigh-and-divide filling.

dupe_check.catalog: Not a duplicate. Closest is turkey-taco-casserole (same protein + taco flavor family) but that is a layered casserole built on tortillas + seasoned black beans + salsa + sour cream (a carb base), whereas this is a low-carb individual stuffed-pepper entree with no starch base - different format and starch, genuinely different plate. turkey-stuffed-pepper-soup is a rice soup with classic (worcestershire/parmesan) seasoning, not taco. turkey-taco-rice-skillet and turkey-taco-soup both carry rice and are skillet/soup formats. philly-cheesesteak-stuffed-peppers (accepted) shares only the stuffed-pepper vessel but is beef + cheesesteak flavor.

cross_protein_flag: Structurally a taco-seasoned ground-meat-baked-in-bell-peppers dish. Decider should watch for a same-dish-different-protein twin in the BEEF pool (a 'ground beef taco stuffed peppers') or a chicken taco stuffed pepper - those would collide on flavor + vessel + method with only the protein differing.
